suggestions: I'm grateful for a smooth, incident-free deployment going into the weekend.
I'm thankful for the quiet stillness and clarity of mind right before Fajr.
I'm grateful for that sudden breakthrough after spending hours debugging a stubborn issue.
I'm thankful for a warm cup of teh tarik kurang manis to recharge during an afternoon slump.
I'm grateful for the rezeki of a stable career that allows me to build things I'm proud of while helping my family.
I'm thankful for the cool morning rain tapping against the window while I start my morning standup.
I'm grateful for helpful teammates who jump on a quick huddle without hesitation when tests fail.
I'm thankful for the chance to step away from screens to catch Maghrib at the local surau and reset my perspective.
I'm grateful for my mum's home-cooked sambal waiting for me after a mentally draining sprint.
I'm thankful for a painless, delay-free LRT commute where I had time to read and decompress.
I'm grateful for the satisfaction of finally clearing my Jira board and closing all pending pull requests.
I'm thankful for good health and barakah in the hours of my day, even when workloads feel heavy.
I'm grateful for casual mamak sessions with close friends where we can talk about life beyond tech.
I'm thankful for constructive code reviews that challenge me to become a more thoughtful engineer.
I'm grateful for an uninterrupted evening to unwind, game, and recharge before another busy week.
